Grit jeet hai.
Taqat jeet se nahin aati.
Grit mushkilon mein saath deti hai.
Himmat zindagi ka fuel hai.
Fear itna hi deep jitna mind allow karta.
Khamoshi trust build karti hai.
Jis din hum un cheezon par chup ho jaate hain jo matter karti hain, us din zindagi ka end shuru hota hai.
Grit hai, zindagi ko matters samajh ke jeena.
Silence woh space hai jahan answers aate.
Bahaduri sahi kaam karna hai.
Himmat matlab jo sahi, woh karna.
Toughness: pata ho tum bach jaoge.
Tabhi bolo jab aapka bolna khamoshi se behtar ho.
Jo apne aap ko jeet leta hai, wahi sabse powerful warrior hai.
Grit matlab gehri himmat hai.
Jitna hum unn cheezon ko value karte hain jo hum bol nahi sakte, utna hum zyada silent ho jaate hain.
Dard ko taqat mein badalna—grit.
Khamoshi pavitra hai.
